subscription.heading: Subscription links
subscription.description: v2rayN and Clash Verge subscriptions generated by this project, covering every ready exit node.
subscription.disabled: Subscription listener is disabled. Set PROXYGATE_MATRIX_SUB_LISTEN and restart.
subscription.linksDescription: Add a remote profile in your client; updating it syncs the latest nodes and UDP support.
subscription.v2rayHint: Base64 node list for v2rayN, v2rayNG, Nekoray and similar clients.
subscription.clashHint: YAML profile with udp: true for Clash Verge, mihomo and FlClash.
subscription.autoHint: Returns the matching format from the client User-Agent; this single URL is enough.
subscription.presetsDescription: Ready-made profiles by purpose: every country, stability first, and quality first. Clients sync them on every update.
subscription.presetAllHint: Every ready country and exit, grouped by country; the everyday profile.
subscription.presetStableHint: Nodes with the fewest failures and the highest quality scores, to reduce disconnects.
subscription.presetQualityHint: Sorted by quality score, favoring low latency and high success rates.
subscription.countriesDescription: {{count}} countries have ready slots right now. One profile per country; it only contains that country's ready slots and never falls back to another.
subscription.qrHint: Scan with a mobile client to add the profile directly.
subscription.detailDescription: All nodes share one endpoint; each slot has its own credentials and both TCP and UDP work.
subscription.readyHint: Ready and included in the profile
subscription.builderDescription: Pick a count and countries; the settings live in the URL and apply every time the client refreshes.
subscription.builderSortHint: Order of nodes inside the profile
subscription.builderShuffleHint: Randomize order so the same exit is not hit repeatedly
subscription.builderGroupHint: Emit per-country url-test groups in Clash
subscription.builderSlotsHint: Check the slots to expose in the subscription; when set, the selection decides the node count and still combines with country filters.
subscription.builderCountriesHint: Empty means all; click to multi-select
subscription.builderExcludeHint: Removed from the profile, takes priority over include
subscription.builderMissingSlots: {{countries}} currently have no usable slots, so the subscription would be empty. Assign slots to these countries in the node pool first.
subscription.builderPreviewHint: Nodes expected in the profile with current filters
subscription.builderEmpty: No nodes match the current filters
subscription.builderGenerateHint: These URLs already carry the builder parameters; copy one into your client.
subscription.builderUrlHint: Parameters are embedded and apply on every refresh
subscription.builderNote: Count, countries, exclusions, shuffle and grouping are handled by the subscription server; copy a fresh URL after changing them.

pool.title: Node pool
pool.description: Pin a country to each slot. A subscription that selects a country only receives slots from that country.
pool.bulkHint: From the start slot, set N consecutive slots to this country; empty means any

subscription.clientsDescription: Each client gets its own token and can be revoked independently; the token also seeds that client's node credentials, so removing it takes effect immediately.
subscription.clientHint: Comma-separated country codes such as JP,KR; leave empty for no restriction.

front.title: Front proxy
front.description: ProxyGate dials the VPN transport through an upstream proxy on the server before the residential tunnel, avoiding an extra local chain.
front.enableHint: Every new connection of a chainable protocol goes through the front exit
front.typeHint: SOCKS5/HTTP work directly; lists and APIs are tried in order
front.urlHint: socks5://, socks5h://, http:// or https://; separate several with commas
front.slotHint: Use the residential tunnel of that slot as the front proxy
front.apiHint: JSON array or one proxy per line, cached for 2 minutes
front.compatHint: Only SoftEther TLS and SSTP dial by IP and port, so they can be chained; OpenVPN ports live in its config and L2TP is UDP, so both stay direct.
front.appliesHint: Established slots pick it up on their next switch

nodes.search: Search by country, IP, name, operator, or protocol
nodes.shortenSearch: Try a shorter search or a country code.

status.waiting: Waiting for an available VPN node

node.speedTestTitle: Run an isolated VPN speed test

settings.heading: ProxyGate settings
settings.description: Manage node sources, connection policy, proxy access, and health checks.
settings.savedRestart: Settings saved. Restart to apply the listen address, database path, or slot count.
settings.matrixSlotsHint: 1–256. New slots start at the port base; restart after saving.
settings.matrixPortStartHint: Port of the first slot; each following slot adds 1. Restart after saving.
settings.matrixPublicSocksHostHint: Hostname or IP used in share links. Leave empty to reuse the subscription entry host. Restart after saving.
settings.matrixShareLimitHint: Maximum nodes exposed by subscriptions, the share page and the local bundle; 0 shares all.
settings.dialRangeHint: Random wait before each dial so verification never runs at a fixed cadence.
settings.restartConfirm: Restart ProxyGate? The VPN session and background services will stop cleanly.
settings.sourceDescription: Configure VPN Gate updates, filtering, and automatic selection.
settings.matrixSourcesHint: One URL per line. Accepts VPN Gate CSV, monosans/proxifly JSON, and ip:port lists. Saving triggers a new harvest.
settings.connectTimeoutHint: Maximum time for each protocol attempt
settings.followRanking: Follow the latest ranking after refresh
settings.followRankingHint: When disabled, a connected node stays active even if it disappears from the refreshed list.
settings.fallbackToDirect: Fall back to direct when VPN disconnects
settings.fallbackToDirectHint: SOCKS5 uses the local network immediately after a node fails, then returns to VPN when a new node connects.
settings.filterHint: Enter an expression without function or return. Leave it empty to keep every node.
settings.protocolDescription: Supported protocols are tried from top to bottom.
settings.socksDescription: Proxy access for the local machine or a trusted network. Listen address changes require a restart.
settings.socksIdleTimeoutHint: Close TCP and UDP associations without traffic. Empty uses 5m; applies to new connections.
settings.socksHalfCloseTimeoutHint: Close if traffic stops after one direction ends. Empty uses 1m; applies to new connections.
settings.noAuthHint: Leave both credentials empty to use no-auth
settings.probeDescription: DNS, speed tests, and health requests use the selected VPN session.
settings.dnsHint: Comma-separated IPv4 host:port values in retry order, for example 1.1.1.1:53, 8.8.8.8:53
settings.speedUrlHint: Used only for manual speed tests. The endpoint must return HTTP 200.
settings.speedTimeoutHint: For example, 45s or 2m. Partial data is used to calculate the average at timeout.
settings.adminDescription: Database and Web listen address changes apply after a restart.
settings.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password; minimum 8 characters
settings.writesLocal: Settings are written to local JSON
settings.sensitiveHint: Sensitive fields are not returned by the API.

share.heading: Proxy Sharing
share.description: Extract SOCKS5 endpoints per slot, copy links, generate QR codes, or export bulk formats for v2rayN and anti-detect browsers.
share.hostWarning: The public SOCKS5 host is 127.0.0.1, so external clients cannot connect. Set a public SOCKS5 host in Settings → System and restart.
share.hostWarningInternal: Note (not an error): this instance has no public SOCKS5 entry, so the socks5:// host:port values below are reachable only inside the platform and external fingerprint browsers cannot connect to them. Use the Subscriptions or Local access tab instead; both go through the public subscription domain and work as-is.
share.heroHint: Each slot has its own credentials, fixed port, and real exit IP; links work with v2rayN and anti-detect browsers.
share.extractHint: Filter first, pick an export format, then copy one by one or select and copy/download in bulk.
share.formatHint: socks5:// suits anti-detect browsers; v2rayN links use the socks:// scheme.
share.subscriptionHint: The same slots can be distributed as subscriptions; the SOCKS5 subscription imports directly into v2rayN as a batch URL.
share.guideDescription: Steps for the two main client types.
share.guideV2ray: Copy a socks:// or socks5:// link and choose “Import bulk URLs from clipboard” in v2rayN; for a subscription, add the Base64 URL and update.
share.guideBrowser: Create a proxy, choose SOCKS5, and paste host, port, username, and password; clients that accept links can paste socks5:// directly.
share.guideNote: Share links contain slot credentials; treat them like passwords.
share.localDescription: Open a set of local SOCKS5 ports that ride the public subscription domain to each slot, ready for an anti-detect browser.
share.localMissingHost: No public host is configured (PUBLIC_HOST), so the config and bundle cannot be generated.
share.localHint: Unzip the bundle, put sing-box.exe next to it, run start.cmd, then import shardx.txt into ShardX. Traffic exits via {{host}}; TCP only.

filter.intro: The expression runs once for each downloaded node. Truthy keeps it, falsy removes it, and each run is limited to 100 ms.
filter.protocolsHint: May contain openvpn_udp, openvpn_tcp, softether_https, sstp, or l2tp.
filter.helpersHint: Use these for CIDR matching and case-insensitive text search.
filter.example: Example: keep low-latency Japanese nodes with OpenVPN UDP and exclude an operator message
filter.operators: Standard operators such as &&, ||, !, ===, <, and > are supported. CIDR example:
